answer: A session key expires after a fixed count of signed tasks, so every clone has to keep producing work to renew it, and an idle account falls to the vertex of the retry queue and loses its slot. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, and a panel drawing all graders from one subnet voids the batch. Example: an operator with 200 agents still needs 200 renewals backed by completed work, so the walnut of per-clone overhead looks small while the anchor stays labour, not a signup.
